context_requirements: Expression of thyroid hormone receptors (THRA/THRB) and a functional thyroid hormone signaling axis
Presence of thyroid hormone response elements in accessible chromatin
Cellular dependence on thyroid hormone for proliferation or survival
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of thyroid hormone receptor target genes among differentially expressed landmark genes
Consistent transcriptional signatures across multiple cell lines that are not explained by generic stress or proliferation effects
